name: Leo
description: Frieda is a lively Scottish Terrier with a charming personality. She loves playing in the yard and is great with children. Her beautiful coat requires regular grooming to keep it looking perfect.

name: Moka
description: Gina is an affectionate Scottish Terrier who enjoys cuddles and short walks. She's house-trained and knows basic commands. Perfect for apartment living!

name: Collins
description: Collins is a playful French Bulldog with lots of energy. He loves playing with toys and gets along well with other dogs. His adorable snorts will melt your heart!

name: Melissa
description: Melissa is an energetic Boxer who needs plenty of exercise. She's incredibly loyal and protective of her family. Great for active households!

name: Jeanine
description: Jeanine is a sweet French Bulldog who prefers lazy afternoons. She's calm, gentle, and loves attention. Currently needs vaccination updates.

name: Elvia
description: Elvia is a curious French Bulldog who loves exploring new environments. She's intelligent and quick to learn new tricks. Very food-motivated!

name: Latisha
description: Latisha is the perfect family dog! This Golden Retriever is gentle with children, loves swimming, and is always eager to please. Great for first-time owners.

name: Coleman
description: Coleman is an athletic Golden Retriever who would make an excellent hiking companion. He's intelligent, loyal, and loves outdoor adventures.

name: Nichole
description: Nichole is a social butterfly! This French Bulldog loves meeting new people and gets along with other pets. Perfect for social households.

name: Fran
description: Fran is a mature Boxer with a calm demeanor. She's past the puppy stage and enjoys relaxing with her family while still being playful when encouraged.

name: Leonor
description: Leonor is a protective Boxer who forms strong bonds with her family. She's intelligent and responds well to positive reinforcement training.

name: Dean
description: Dean has the classic Scottish Terrier independence but is very loyal to his humans. He enjoys brisk walks and has a charming, confident personality.

name: Stevenson
description: Stevenson is a low-energy French Bulldog perfect for apartment living. He's affectionate and loves napping in sunny spots. Needs vaccination updates.

name: Kristina
description: Kristina is a mature Golden Retriever with a gentle soul. She's great with seniors and enjoys leisurely walks. Very well-mannered and calm.

name: Ethel
description: Ethel is a young, energetic Golden Retriever who loves playing fetch. She's highly trainable and eager to learn new commands. Great for active families!

name: Terry
description: Terry is a friendly Golden Retriever who loves everyone he meets. He's excellent with children and other pets. Would thrive in a family environment with a yard.
